title.narrative: My tank: Empowering Communities with Rainwater Harvesting
My tank: Empowering Communities with Rainwater Harvesting

description.narrative: The overall objective (s) of the Project is to address the water scarcity issues faced by the local community households and two schools in Kisima ward by implementing rainwater harvesting systems. The primary objective of the project is to enhance access to clean water for the target beneficiaries, leading to improved quality of life and socio-economic development in the area.

Projektet kommer att hantera det vattenbrist som råder i Kisma området genom att förbättra systemet för uppsamling av regnvatten. Det primära målet med projektet är att förbättra tillgången till rent vatten för den lokala befolkningen samt två utvalda skolor, vilket kommer att resultera i förbättrad livskvalitet och socioekonomisk utveckling i området.

The project aims to address the water scarcity issues faced by the local community households and two schools in Kisima ward by implementing rainwater harvesting systems. The primary objective of the project is to enhance access to clean water for the target beneficiaries, leading to improved quality of life and socio-economic development in the area.

description.narrative: The Sida Contribution No. 16778, My Tank: Empowering Communities with Rainwater Harvesting to Enhance Water Access and Livelihoods in Meru County, Kenya, is a new contribution with Activity Period 1 March 2024 to 28 February 2027. The project is still in in the first months of its implementation. The first annual narrative and financial reports covering the period from 1st March 2024 to 28th February, 2025 shall be submitted to the Embassy of Sweden in Nairobi by 31st May, 2025.
